text_block_list.text:
――January 3rd. Right in the middle of the New Year's holidays.
As I struggle with the towering piles of documents――

Out of nowhere, Admire Groove
poked her head into the Trainer's office.
choice_data_list: Alv? Um... Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...There you are.
Perfect timing."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
May I borrow a few books?
Ones about training theory and sports medicine—
choice_data_list: If I remember right... it got mixed up with the documents over there...

text_block_list.text: I glance over at the chaotic spread of documents on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's far too messy in here.
What have you been doing since the new year started?
choice_data_list: Compiling and analyzing race data...
Well, roughly speaking, it's studying nutrition.
Studying past Tiara races, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Data on the Umamusume in my generation...?
Physical data, race tendencies...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is not just official records, is it?
As for the unofficial data... did you scout it out yourself?
choice_data_list: Because what's most valuable to you is accurate information.
Because what's most valuable to you is accurate information.

text_block_list.text:
Classic GⅠs are races where the very best of the generation gather.
Misjudging the flow of battle will result in a fatal disadvantage.

However, she possesses the ability to execute even
complex countermeasures immediately, so long as they are shared beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Handing me something that looks like an encyclopedia
doesn't really help me much, you know."
choice_data_list: This data... I'll use it in the "Uma-lator"!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Umulator... Come to think of it, there was indeed
a VR simulator by that name...

The academy houses a high-performance VR machine.
Its name is the "VR Umalator."
It is often used as a race simulator at the academy and boasts excellent customizability.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, this mountain of data is to be used for those settings?
choice_data_list: Alv, could you give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: I guarantee it'll be useful!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...If it's just once.
I start up the program and configure the various parameters.
choice_data_list: Then we'll go with our next immediate goal, the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Do whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Visual, auditory, tactile... operational feedback normal.
Simulation, ready to initiate.
choice_data_list: Then I'll send the opposing Umamusume over there too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're doing this, put "her" in as well.
You have all the data gathered, don't you?"

She sets up the opponent Umamusume as requested.
Naturally, that opponent is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Even if it's just virtual data,
this should at least provide a bit of a challenge, I suppose.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Let's get started already.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...The other virtual Umamusume besides Still-san are highly capable too... I need to break away early...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (! ...An opening is clearing up, through here...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! The Umamusume in front is dropping back, blocking the path...?
And the others are making their move sooner than expected...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! I can't break free...!

text_block_list.name: System Voice
text_block_list.text:
—Simulation program:
Oka Sho concluded.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
What kind of settings
did you configure for that virtual Umamusume's data?
choice_data_list: I've adjusted for everyone's growth up until spring.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...No wonder every single opponent was able to keep up in the clash.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What made the Umamusume in front slow down midway?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I believe she originally had the stamina
to run the full Oka Sho, though."
choice_data_list: I guess it was the result of everyone's racing styles influencing each other.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I see. So that's the result of realistically recreating even the impatience, mistakes, and irregularities.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...So, when will we be able to use it properly?
You were entering data, right?
choice_data_list: Um, I still have about half left...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Let's finish it. Everything that's left.
choice_data_list: All of it!?

text_block_list.text: With Admire Groove helping me out, I somehow managed to finish entering the data...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Then—I shall re-verify it now.
choice_data_list: It's already evening, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once the holiday is over, more people will start using it, right?
Now is the time to dedicate our hours to it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Next, change the gate positions as specified.
Once that's done—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Please set the simulated Still-san's stats one tier higher.
choice_data_list: (Looks like I won't be able to go home for a while...!)

text_block_list.text: Afterward, I stayed with Admire Groove until she was satisfied, making it late at night by the time I got home—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
Nutritional science, or rather... a recipe book...?"
choice_data_list: Because it's important for Alv this year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, her body is still developing.
As her trainer, don't forget that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This is just a fraction of the know-how I learned from my mother... Make sure you read it.
The body-conditioning know-how Air Groove shared at the end of the year contained plenty of nutritional science, and I was right in the middle of testing various things out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
So... you're trying to get me
to eat something, is that it?
choice_data_list: I'm about to make some right now, so maybe you can taste-test it for me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, how are your cooking skills?
choice_data_list: ...Normal?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...If it looks suspicious at first glance, let's reject it.)
After moving to the kitchen, we spread out the procured ingredients.
choice_data_list: Which one of those recipes do you want to eat?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'm the one who decides?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Most of these dishes are either hard to call appetizing
even out of politeness, or overly complicated...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Hm? ...What's this...
A menu specialized for hypertrophy and muscle fatigue recovery...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Its nutritional value far surpasses ordinary cooking,
yet fats are kept to an absolute minimum.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is this... curry?
choice_data_list: It comes recommended. How are you with curry?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...As long as it's not too spicy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...That said, none of the other options really appealed to me, and a menu with this much nutritional value is hard to pass up.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(There are several spices that cannot be left out for their medicinal benefits.
The key is simply neutralizing this flavor—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll adjust the recipe to my liking.
Please memorize it on the first try."
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Please grate this for me.
choice_data_list: It's rich in fiber too, looks like a good choice.
It's rich in fiber too, seems like a good choice, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Next is honey milk.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's also add bananas.
choice_data_list: ...Pretty sweet, isn't it?
...Pretty sweet, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm the one eating it, after all.
choice_data_list: Y... Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If that is the case, I don't mind
incorporating it into my body-building diet.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If you're happy with the original recipe, feel free to enjoy it all by yourself, Trainer.
And after that, I often found myself making that sweet curry.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No wonder there were old video recordings around...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...When is this footage from?
Isn't it from quite a long time ago?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even if a race shares the same name,
over the span of a few decades, the entire landscape changes drastically.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even this footage shows it.
Large patches of turf have been torn up.
The track maintenance system is completely different.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: With advances in sports medicine and nutrition, an Umamusume's physical build is different from what it used to be.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: To be frank, I question its usefulness as reference data.
choice_data_list: What I was focused on is what comes next.
What I was paying attention to was what came next.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The rest...?
Admire Groove's opinion is correct if you're looking primarily at things like lap times.
However, if the primary focus is on "winning the race," that may not necessarily hold true across the board.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
“Now, 400 meters remaining in this fierce battle!
Looping around the outside—”

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"She surged smoothly from behind...!
She closes in... and crosses the goal...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Brilliant. Moving from the middle-back of the pack to the outside in an instant, seizing the perfect position...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Predicting shifts in open space.
A precise movement diving into the 'correct' route
without straying a single step...)
choice_data_list: The tactics that conquer the Summit Showdown transcend eras.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A tactic... that transcends the ages.
The academy preserves ancient historical documents not just for their historical value.
"She sometimes teaches me know-how that will be useful even down the road."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (To master the tactics of every Tiara winner in history and surpass every single one of them...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(If I do that—
it might even help when I face her in battle...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Let's head to the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew...!
choice_data_list: Surpassing the past champions, huh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
If that will give me strength...
And so, with boundless ambition, she devoted herself to training even through New Year's.
